answer: Duplicate or cloned identities surface on a public terrace of registered proofs, where peers challenge collisions and slash the bond. A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each reputation slot to a verifiable proof-of-personhood beacon that issues one credential per human, then require every agent kernel to stake that credential alongside a bonded deposit. An attacker must recruit many real, unique humans or forfeit staked capital per fake identity, making mass sybil creation costly and detectable. In practice, Agent0244 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
